A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''lieutenant''' served on the bridge of the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] ''[[Intrepid]]'' during [[Operation Hammerblow]], the final live fire operational readiness exercise for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]].
